## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] New behavior has automated tests or a documented reason it cannot.
- [ ] Core tests pass on a supported Python version.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] User-visible commands and behavior are documented.
- [ ] Model, data, media, and dependency licenses are documented when relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, private media, model weights, raw `runs/`, or personal paths are committed.
- [ ] Mock results are not presented as real-model capability.
- [ ] Experiment numbers link to raw evidence and state their limitations.
